The
DocCheck Shop
features an assortment of over 12,000 medical and practice supplies, partnering with leading global medical equipment manufacturers and featuring its own dedicated design lines.
www.doccheckshop.eu
Major Manufacturer Brands & Partners
Littmann (3M):
Authorized dealer supplying acoustic stethoscopes and replacement parts.
HEINE Optotechnik:
Provider of diagnostic lights, otoscopes, and dermatoscopes.
HARTMANN:
Supplier of clinical care, hygiene, and medical consumable products.
boso (Bosch + Sohn):
Manufacturer of blood pressure monitors and sphygmomanometers.
Braun:
Producer of professional thermometers and digital diagnostic hardware.
servoprax:
Source for general practice requirements, consumables, and clinic setup items.
www.doccheckshop.eu
DocCheck In-House Brands
DocCheck Thïngs:
The company's proprietary label focusing on redesigned, aesthetically distinct, and repairable medical instruments (such as diagnostic penlights, reflex hammers, and stethoscopes).
DocCheck Tools:
Dedicated line for everyday medical practice consumables and basic supplies.
www.doccheckshop.eu
